    History & Milestones

    1412: CHRIST (Deemed to be University) was born out of the educational vision of St Kuriakose Elias Chavara, an educationalist and social reformer of the nineteenth century in South India. He founded the first Catholic indigenous congregation, Carmelites of Mary Immaculate (CMI), in 1831 which administers CHRIST (Deemed to be University). 1417: 1419: “CHRIST (Deemed to be University) was established as ‘Christ College’ in 1969. It undertook path-breaking initiatives in Indian higher education with the introduction of innovative and modern curricula, insistence on academic discipline, imparting of Holistic Education and adoption of global higher education practices with the support of creative and dedicated staff.” 1422: The University Grants Commission (UGC) of India conferred Autonomy to Christ College in 2004 and identified it as an Institution with Potential for Excellence in 2006. In 2008 under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, the Ministry of Human Resource Development of the Government of India, declared the institution a Deemed to be University, in the name and style of Christ University. One of the first institutions in India to be accredited in 1998 by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC), Government of India, and subsequently in 2004, 2016, 2022 CHRIST (Deemed to be University) is currently accredited with ‘A+’ Grade. The University is ranked among top 100 universities in India at 63 in the NIRF India Ranking 2025 of Ministry of Education, Government of India. 1428: 1430: The multi-disciplinary University which focuses on teaching, research and service offers Bachelor, Master and Doctoral programmes in humanities, social sciences, sciences, commerce, management, engineering, architecture, education, and law to about 40000+ students. The University offers its programmes at four campus locations in Bangalore in Karnataka, at Lavasa in Pune in Maharashtra, and Ghaziabad in Delhi NCR. 1433: The campus is a living example of harmonious multiculturalism with students from all the states and union territories and around 60 different countries. CHRIST (Deemed to be University) publishes six peer-reviewed research journals and has published more than 300 books in Kannada and English. A promoter of sports, music and literary activities, it is a nurturing ground for creative excellence. 1438: 1442:

 Message from Dean 
 I am extremely pleased to extend a warm welcome to the School of Psychological Sciences, CHRIST (Deemed to be University) Bangalore Central Campus on behalf of all faculty,  students and staff. The School of Psychological Sciences at CHRIST (Deemed to be University) Bangalore Central campus benefits from a rich tradition of academic  lineage wherein students are guided through a transformative journey of holistic development. Students  are provided various opportunities to grow personally, academically and also socially, putting them on the road to becoming a responsible citizen. The school offers  various undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs in Psychology. The school offers various undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in Psychology, all of which are designed to meet and exceed national and international benchmarks in academic rigor, professional relevance, and ethical standards. These programs are aligned with global best practices and are tailored to equip students with competencies that are recognized and valued both in India and worldwide. All the programs offered by the school help students  discover  knowledge and appreciate scientific content with rigor and ethical stance. The  programs also facilitate development of skills required for practice, application and  research, nurturing critical and creative thinking skills.  
 Being a part of the school, every student undergoes extensive training and has a humbling exposure of moulding themselves to be future leaders and strive towards excellence and service. The School of Psychological Sciences embraces its responsibility in preparing future professionals who are equipped to face the contemporary challenges of the 21st century and facilitate training for them through community engagement. The curriculum for all the programs is also constantly and extensively reviewed to keep it closer to current updates in knowledge and the real world situations.The various academic programmes organised by the school in the form of conferences, seminars, workshops, conclaves, trainings, internships ensure utmost academic rigour. Our distinguished faculty also work closely with students by giving individualised attention as and when necessary and providing all the students with innovative learning opportunities.The School of Psychological Sciences invites you to explore our website to learn more about various education opportunities available with us. We will be happy to assist you with any of your queries. 
 School Facilities 
 In order to encourage the students to participate in departmental activities, our university gives access to 
 students to make use of the multiple facilities provided in the campus.
